svg.text: claudia — Server settings ▸ Fonts ▸ Add fonts…: check first, then add, proposed (E3.3)
A dialog over the Fonts page. Nothing on the server changes until step B is confirmed. The licence record is mandatory (D94).
A · Files chosen, licence said in words
The files' own licence fields are read; when they name none, the administrator says it.

B · Checked: what will be added, said before it happens
Each file gets a line. The confirmation names the server and the scope, as in the danger-zone pages.
